title: NEB Class 11 English — Literature — 2023
subject: english
source: NEB Grade 11 Model Questions / NEB Past Papers 2020-2024

questions.question: Identify the literary device used: 'The wind whispered through the trees.'
questions.solution: **Device: Personification** — the wind (non-human) is given the human quality of whispering.
questions.knowledgeNote: Common literary devices: Simile (like/as), Metaphor (direct comparison), Personification (human qualities to non-human), Alliteration (repeated initial sounds), Onomatopoeia (sound words).
